purpose.zh: 练托马斯全旋要的单手单脚侧撑劲
purpose.en: Builds the one-hand, one-foot side support you need for flares.

text.zh: 下面的手和脚撑地，身子差不多放平
text.en: Push through your bottom hand and foot, body almost level

text.zh: 上面的腿抬起来，另一只手往上伸直。
text.en: Lift your top leg and reach your free arm straight up.

text.zh: 撑地的手推地，肩膀离耳朵远点。
text.en: Push the floor away so your shoulder stays away from your ear.

cautions.zh: 一只手扛全身，先把手腕转开，疼就别做
cautions.en: One hand carries everything. Warm up your wrists, and skip it if they hurt.

cautions.zh: 手腕或肩膀疼就少撑几秒，还疼就停；撑不住就把上面那条腿放下来
cautions.en: If your wrist or shoulder hurts, hold for less time. Stop if it still hurts. Can't hold it? Lower your top leg.

changes: 主口令「同侧手和下方脚」改成「下面的手和脚」
